description: This file defines a central theme configuration for a Flutter application using Material 3 design principles. It encapsulates color schemes, text styles, and component themes to ensure visual consistency across the app. The main class, AppTheme, provides a static getter for a customized light theme.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that centralizes the Material 3 theme configuration for the application, exposing a styled light theme based on predefined color palettes and style guidelines.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: A static getter that returns a ThemeData object configured with a custom ColorScheme, typography, and component themes, aligning with Material 3 design and the specified style guide.
